title: Measuring an artificial intelligence agent's trust in humans using machine incentives
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The study measures an AI agent's trust-like behavior towards a human experimenter in an economic 'trust game' under different incentive conditions (real vs. hypothetical).
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on measuring an AI's trust in humans using economic game theory and incentives.
